bbox_format: [left, top, right, bottom], right and bottom exclusive; alpha >= 128
notes: All selected images inspected visually and through read-only PNG metadata/alpha checks.
All selected images have genuine alpha transparency, no rendered checkerboard, and contain one complete weapon.
Native framing fills roughly 83–96% of the canvas rather than requested 75%; use supplied alpha bounding boxes for display scaling.
Selected images may have low-alpha edge haze. No programmatic cleanup was applied.

Each weapon had one initial generation with the supplied style-reference image; all initial images were rejected because they were RGB with a rendered checkerboard. One independent native retry per weapon produced the selected RGBA output.
